name: Facade
summary: Provides a single, higher level interface to a set of interfaces in a subsystem, making that subsystem easier to use.

reference.author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides

roles.name: Facade
roles.summary: Offers the simplified entry point, and knows which subsystem type handles each request.

roles.name: Subsystem
roles.summary: Does the real work, and knows nothing about the facade.
